why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. Discovery is already covered here: mvp-mode is invoked at the start of every task, maps the situation to its unit and, when unsure or asked what exists, reads the generated catalog, whose slash-only table names every manual workflow with a line on when to use it; mvp-mode suggests those rather than starting them, and the legacy /skill-router entry points to it. A separate user-invoked router would repeat that list for the person to start by hand, and authoring guidance to build one would change no behaviour in this harness (AGENTS.md:93-94; .claude/skills/mvp-mode/SKILL.md:28-32; .claude/skills/mvp-mode/references/catalog.md:24-57; .claude/skills/mvp-mode/references/catalog.md:52; .claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/SKILL.md:8-9).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/productivity/writing-for-agents#criterion-before-isolation
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3. Adopted: if an agent ends a step early because later steps are in view, first sharpen that step's completion criterion (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/references/writing-principles.md:17-18). The remedy is one conditional paragraph in authoring-for-agents' writing principles (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/references/writing-principles.md:17-19), which the skill routes to for structural choices, naming this case (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/SKILL.md:50-52). The skill fires whenever agent instructions are created or changed (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/SKILL.md:3), and its verify step revises the smallest implicated instruction after a failed case (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/SKILL.md:63-64).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/productivity/writing-for-agents#triad-collapse
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3, accepting the report's reject recommendation. subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/productivity/writing-for-agents#observed-rushing-context-isolation
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-20 (conversation), deferred review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3. The remedy is one conditional paragraph in authoring-for-agents' writing principles (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/references/writing-principles.md:17-19), which the skill routes to for structural choices, naming this case (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/SKILL.md:50-52). The skill fires whenever agent instructions are created or changed (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/SKILL.md:3), and its verify step revises the smallest implicated instruction after a failed case (.claude/skills/authoring-for-agents/SKILL.md:63-64).
